name: Why does my kitchen sink smell bad even after cleaning?

mainEntity.name: Why does my kitchen sink smell bad even after cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: A persistent bad smell from your kitchen sink, even after cleaning, often indicates trapped food particles, grease, or bacterial growth within the drain pipes, P-trap, or garbage disposal. Sometimes, sewer gas can also escape if the P-trap dries out or is improperly installed. As a first-party insight, our technicians frequently find that household cleaning methods don't fully eliminate these deeper organic buildups, which often require professional cleaning or inspection to resolve the underlying issue causing the odor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Persistent bad smells usually mean trapped food, grease, or bacteria in the pipes or disposal. Professional cleaning or inspection is often needed.
